sections.heading: Beginner Tips and Tricks

The red ants, on the other hand, are a major threat, as they will end your game if you tap them. Make sure to avoid them at all costs, and focus on crushing the green ants instead.

Another tip is to use your fingers to tap the ants, rather than your mouse or keyboard. This will give you more control and accuracy, making it easier to crush the ants and progress through the levels. Finally, make sure to take breaks and rest your fingers, as the game can be quite challenging and require a lot of concentration. Overall, 'Crush these Ants' is a game that requires skill and strategy, but with practice and patience, you'll be able to master it in no time.
